note: Both sets correctly capture the four Table 6-2 tower properties with supporting quotes, and both contain redundant duplicate claims (A repeats the CM location; B repeats the mass and CM location). Set B is stronger on the damping claim because it retains the stated condition 'isolated tower (without rotor-nacelle assembly mass present)', which Set A drops, keeping only 'all modes'. Set B's minor blemishes are the vague 'conditions: overall' on height and the duplicated mass/CM entries, but no values are misbound or invented in either set. Overall B preserves the needed conditions better at the cost of a couple of trivial duplicates.
